evidence.floor_how: Human-reported maximum relative disagreement on magnitude-carrying entries in five selected official models and ten output types, comparing a native x86 build with legacy reference-machine outputs. This is not an all-73-deck floor or a K-mimic sensitivity measurement. The human-selected bounds remain unchanged; additive rescoring of saved arm64 outputs is diagnostic until a fresh CLI selfcheck.

warrant: Each original text table is compared separately with abs(candidate-reference) <= atol[file] + 1e-4*abs(reference); the human-selected atols remain scalCls=1e2, lensedCls/lensedtotCls/lenspotentialCls/totCls/scalarCovCls=1e-1, tensCls=1e-2, matterpower=1, and transfer_out=1e3. The three K-mouflage decks use the exact models.txt selector and the unmodified pinned source; their retained arm64 calibration had zero failures with combined margins above 20. config.f90:40 sets base_tol=1e-4 and transfer_high_precision=T makes the scalar integration tolerance 1e-6 in cmbmain.f90:1109-1111. Revision 5.6.0 says: "A heavy tail in a diagnostic array while the state arrays are clean is not a reason to abandon pointwise; give that array its own bound or exclude it as diagnostic, and say which in the warrant." Tensor output is exercised through get_tensor_cls=T while vector initialv/derivsv/outputv remain owned but uncovered because get_vector_cls=F. halofit is excluded because do_nonlinear=0; InitialPower is shared and exercised by every check; DarkEnergyInterface.f90 and DarkEnergyFluid.f90 are shared GR-baseline dependencies, while PowellMinimize belongs to the models/background module. The K-mouflage bound is unchanged pending the split-check selfcheck; no K-mimic sensitivity is pooled into it.
